x-ectwin.runs_in: Commons ingest jobs for text-bearing feeds (ingest-sngr-alerts, ingest-inamhi-advertencias, ingest-cnerfen-inocar, SITREP and gaceta harvesters), after the raw capture is written

placeholders.expected_content: One-line description of what this endpoint normally returns, from catalog/data-sources.yaml
placeholders.http_status_bucket: Bucket from code: '200 with body', '200 with empty or tiny body', '3xx redirect', '403', '404', '5xx'
placeholders.body_excerpt: First 2,000 characters of the response body as text (HTML tags stripped by code)
placeholders.previous_title: Title or first line of the previous successful capture, or empty string

hard_rules: Every capture from an official source is stored in raw/ regardless of any Jev answer (write-once, AP-09).
Jev answers only raise flags and route to humans; they never suppress or edit official content (D1).
notes: doc_type options mirror official_alerts.doc_type in docs/03-architecture.md section 5.3.
Catches silent failures such as geoblock pages ('fuera de Latinoamerica'), empty bodies with HTTP 200 and maintenance pages.
x-ectwin.output: commons_ops.dq_results (docs/11-operations-runbook.md section 7.2) with check_id 'JEV-DQ-<question>' and severity 'warn'; source status in commons_ops.source_health

is_error_or_block_page.instructions: Does `fetch.body_excerpt` look like an error, access-denied, geographic block, captcha, login or maintenance page instead of real content?

criteria.true: Error message, access denied, 'fuera de Latinoamerica', captcha, login form, maintenance notice, or an empty page
criteria.false: Real data, a real publication or a real alert

announces_official_change.instructions: Does `fetch.body_excerpt` announce a new or changed official alert, advertencia, El Nino status or emergency declaration?

is_correction.instructions: Does `fetch.body_excerpt` say that it corrects, replaces, updates or cancels an earlier publication?

criteria.alerta: An alert declaration or change of alert state
